summary: חֲמָתִי designates a member of the people of Hamath. Genesis uses the singular collectively when it lists the families descended from Canaan.

senses.definition: A member of the people of Hamath, with the singular also designating the people collectively.

evidence.note: הַחֲמָתִי closes the list immediately before the narrator tells how the Canaanite families dispersed.
